model_selection: User selected official glm-5.3-flash API, ten concurrent episode processes
source_screening_rule: Normal STOP; >=20 frames; robot z>=0.55m; XY extent>=2m; <6 consecutive ineffective forward attempts; <=25% ineffective forward (<0.035m) actions.
input_policy: RGB only, native 640x480 crop; last 8 available observations; actions strictly before current observation; visual checkpoint memory. No map, GPS, reference path, outcome or future frames.

evaluation.reference: Previously marked 55 scene crossings; geometric prior, not independent human gold.
evaluation.matching: One prediction per encountered crossing visit; repeated detections penalized.
evaluation.timing: Actions relative to closest approach, not certified pre-choice timing.

crossing_definition: At least two onward choices toward different areas, excluding incoming; partial visual cues may support a branch inference.
selection_rule: First ten episodes in existing dev5_val15 input order; overlaps prior samples, not a fresh blind validation

inference_schedule.tracker_updates: only on actual model responses; no synthetic predictions

authorization: User explicitly requests retry and finish all ten cases
remote_retry_revision: streaming; 8 transient retries with capped exponential backoff; 32768 initial actual output budget, double on length to 131072; independent episode failures
